ablation_scope.attention: Remove attention and its FFNs/gates; the V39 finite input memory and modal residual remain active through SSM.
ablation_scope.common: The same five datasets must pass all ten independent controls; SSM/input-memory/modal-residual and attention/FFN contrasts are nested.
ablation_scope.completion: This package permits Assist2017 Full only. An independently audited pilot strictly above 0.8174 is required before any separately frozen expansion or independent module-control phase. One pilot never completes the same-five-of-eight goal.
ablation_scope.concept_graph: Remove graph only; the V39 finite input memory and modal residual stay active. Requires a fresh matched control after admission.
ablation_scope.evidence: Remove priors, learned statistics, direct evidence logits and support reliability; retain raw historical q/c/r and temporal conditioning.
ablation_scope.factorized_input: Disable the preserved v12 factorized residual path and train the remaining model independently.
ablation_scope.ffn_gate: Remove FFN gates only; the V39 finite input memory and modal residual stay active. Historical V32 is not a matched V43 control.
ablation_scope.history_pace: Remove only V27 historical-time conditioning; Newton readout remains active. A fresh matched control would be required after admission.
ablation_scope.input_memory: Remove the nested V39 finite SSM input memory and modal residual path; V33 is the independently trained control after full parity audits.
ablation_scope.item_attempt_stage: Disable only the ordinal attempt readout; historical time conditioning remains active.
ablation_scope.prequential_newton: Disable only Newton; graph recurrence stays active. A fresh matched control is required after admission.
ablation_scope.ssm: Remove both SSM uses and the nested finite input-memory and modal-residual effects; graph recurrence remains active.

best_candidate.initial_state_use: comparison only; no artifact supplies model initialization

best_candidate_role: V33 is retained control and highest audited observation; V38 is latest completed; V36/V37 are censored

candidate_structure.applicability_limit: metadata coverage and synthetic tests are not positive module evidence
candidate_structure.changed_path: zero-initialized multi-timescale residual memory inside the retained V39 SSM
candidate_structure.disabled_behavior: use_multimode_residual=0 delegates to unchanged V39 SSM; disabling both nested paths delegates to V33
candidate_structure.dropout_policy: no added dropout; original stochastic module calls retained
candidate_structure.extra_cost: 7168 parameters; V39 finite input memory plus two zero-initialized mode-routing matrices; no extra dropout
candidate_structure.formula: z_t=W*x_t+b; z'_t=z_t+sum_{lag=1..4}(w_lag*z_(t-lag)); only original projections are filtered
candidate_structure.initialization: one all-zero [3*d_model,1,4] tensor and two all-zero [num_heads,d_model] matrices; no RNG consumption
candidate_structure.modal_residual_readout: input-conditioned convex readout of eight per-coordinate memories with fixed powers-of-two retention multipliers
candidate_structure.retained_ablation_policy: eight other old-module removals retain both nested V39 paths; no_ssm removes both
candidate_structure.state_scope: batch/window-local finite input memory and modal state; no cache or corrected-projection feedback

completion_requirements: At least the same five of eight datasets exceed all applicable existing reference scores, with references reconciled to the supplied table.
The same five datasets must pass independent evidence, SSM, attention, factorized-input, item-attempt, history-pace, Newton, graph, FFN-gate and finite-input-memory controls.
Positive module AUC effects and learner-cluster uncertainty are audited; single seed42 and validation fold0 remain the user scope.
No baseline or existing incumbent retraining, checkpoint initialization, hyperparameter sweep, extra seed search or silent resource retry.
Preserve learner isolation, training-only vocabularies/priors, immutable source/data/initialization/schedule provenance and causal prediction.
Report reference-score comparisons as descriptive, not matched five-fold or held-out generalization evidence; missing baselines never count as zero.
Assist2017 must pass its unchanged floor and independent audit before any other dataset is run.
dataset_order_rule: explicit user instruction: Assist2017 must pass first
failure_policy: One Assist2017 Full run, max200/patience20. AUC<=0.8174 closes this V39-based modal-residual candidate and related mode count, rate schedule, routing, readout, initialization, width and seed retries. Resource interruption is incomplete, not scientific failure. No baseline/control rerun, sweep or automatic resource resume/retry.

global_admission.dataset_point_gate: Full AUC strictly exceeds that dataset's unchanged reference floor
global_admission.futility_rule: A completed Assist2017 AUC not strictly above 0.8174 closes this candidate. Other datasets cannot rescue a failed pilot and cannot execute in this package.

hypothesis: Finite earlier-input combinations before nonlinear SSM transitions may improve local event modelling. The earlier window error profile is retrospective and does not establish this mechanism as a cause of the AUC gap. Causal convolution already exists in reviewed historical token-smoothing code.

incumbent.initial_state_use: Compare with independently generated random-init tensors only; never initialize or fine-tune from a trained checkpoint.

point_gate.admission: Assist2017 Full strictly exceeds0.8174 and passes independent terminal audit before separately frozen expansion.
point_gate.candidate_minus_best_candidate_auc: Legacy field compares to V33, not completed V38 or interrupted V36/V37
point_gate.candidate_minus_incumbent_auc: Assist2017 reference comparison only; not a cross-dataset metric
point_gate.full_minus_existing_reference_floor_auc: > 0; descriptive comparison, not matched baseline retraining

prospective_protocol_changes.added_capacity_limit: V33 has3072 fewer parameters; no parameter-matched or equal-FLOP claim
prospective_protocol_changes.information_boundary: strictly earlier uncorrected SSM input projections only; no new labels, metadata, loss or persistent learner state
prospective_protocol_changes.new_module_family: Ten planned contrasts, family80; not a correction across all adaptive architecture screens.
prospective_protocol_changes.previous_candidate: V36/V37 are resource-censored and not retried; V38 remains latest completed, V33 retained.
prospective_protocol_changes.source_precedents: Token smoothing, hidden-state feedback, response-conditioned projections, attention score stencils and relative-lag biases were explicitly reviewed.
prospective_protocol_changes.unchanged_scope: one Assist2017 Full run; other datasets and control retraining disabled

reference_snapshot.floor_policy: all eight v15 conservative floors retained without reduction

reference_status: Unchanged conservative floors cover the current adjacent CSV maxima; Assist2017/NIPS retain the stronger paper-only numeric targets. Paper-only values are not represented as matched replications.

resource_policy.limitation: polling detects new arrivals but does not provide a scheduler-exclusive reservation
resource_policy.on_conflict: terminate this job only; preserve partial artifacts; no automatic retry
resource_policy.revision_scope: GPU resource policy only; model, data, initialization and training unchanged

system_display_exception.identity_source: nvidia-smi XML and independent ps PID/UID/username/kernel command

structural_control.initial_state_use: comparison only; no artifact supplies model initialization

training.checkpoint_selection: max validation AUC then min NLL, Brier, ECE15 then earliest epoch

uncertainty.module_effect_evidence_gate: Positive AUC point effects and learner-bootstrap intervals; report both ordinary95% and family-adjusted intervals without claiming training-seed robustness.
uncertainty.multiplicity_family: eight datasets times ten planned contrasts: evidence, SSM, attention, factorized input, item attempt, history pace, Newton, concept graph, FFN gate and finite input memory; nested contrasts are not disjoint
uncertainty.validation_intervals: Exploratory and conditional on validation checkpoint and architecture selection; not held-out or training-seed confirmation.

user_scope: Single fold (validation fold0) and single seed42. At least five of eight identical datasets must pass both all-baseline and independently retrained module gates. Five of five refers to datasets, not seeds.
